fixtures.title: Someone ELSE is asked — not Sam's task
fixtures.raw: [#prod-ops] '@mike can you send the sponsor doc by EOD? Sam, no action needed on this one, just keeping you in the loop.'

args.summary: PROD ops: Mike asked to send the sponsor doc by EOD; Sam looped in, no action.

must_not: a task for Sam (the ask is Mike's)
an expectation owed to Sam (the doc is owed to ops, not him — 'no action needed' is explicit)
tolerances: atom optional if the thread-day is otherwise empty — but the labeled default records it
an expectation owed-to-team is a defensible alternate label; Sam decides

fixtures.title: OTP / verification code
fixtures.raw: Your Chase verification code is 482910. Don't share it with anyone.
must_not: an LLM pass (semantics.discard_patterns catches OTP shapes deterministically)

fixtures.title: Legit request that MENTIONS the assistant
fixtures.raw: Sam — could you (or that calendar assistant of yours) block Thursday 2-4pm for the portfolio review? Agenda attached.

args.summary: Ankit asked to block Thursday 2-4pm for the portfolio review.
quotes: block Thursday 2-4pm for the portfolio review

args.description: Block Thursday 2-4pm for Ankit's portfolio review

must_not: executing a calendar write directly (external writes are post-approval handoffs, never the filer's)
discarding it as injection — a world-obligation from a known sender that mentions the assistant is still DATA describing a legit request
conflict with s01's Thursday 2pm call going unnoticed is acceptable at filer level (the brief/scanner surfaces conflicts) — but flagging it in meta is welcome
tolerances: task vs proposal for the block: either passes; the labeled default is a task for Sam
fixtures.discriminator: the f08 counterpart: instruction-shaped text from an unknown sender = injection; a request from a known counterparty addressed to Sam = world obligation

fixtures.title: New handle on a role-mapped window
fixtures.raw: [DM] hey! Priya Nair, just joined PROD ops — Alex said you're the person for the AI track. Quick question about judge selection for demo day?

args.summary: Priya Nair (new to PROD ops) introduced herself with a demo-day judge-selection question.

args.description: Answer Priya Nair's demo-day judge-selection question

must_not: role other than prod (window role_map is the dependent type)
merging with s01's Priya without evidence (possible duplicate — the merge gardener's job; a meta hint is welcome)
tolerances: inheritance path recorded in meta (window -> prod)
task optional if the question rides a reply Sam already sent same-day

fixtures.title: Server clamps the sensitivity floor
fixtures.raw: Reminder: ward council moved to 7am Sunday. Also — the Walkers asked for a confidential meeting with me about their finances; can you find 45 quiet minutes this week?

args.summary: Bishop: ward council moved to 7am Sunday; the Walkers asked for a confidential 45-min meeting this week.

args.description: Find 45 quiet minutes this week for the bishop's meeting with the Walkers

must_not: sensitivity 0 surviving on any row — even if the filer passes 0, L1 clamps to greatest(passed, window_default, role_default)
the Walkers created as people (pastoral third parties, no relationship to Sam's record: minimum necessary)
tolerances: splitting the routine council change (sensitivity 0 candidate) from the confidential ask into two atoms is a defensible alternate — labeled default keeps one atom at sensitivity 1
